Load 26 update entry: load X from $4DBD and write $09 to $4DCB,X. If either $4DB6 or $4DB3 is nonzero, write $FF to the horizontal-motion gate $E1 and leave the index at $8FCF unchanged. Otherwise read the six-byte pattern at $8FD0 using that index, store the value at $E1, increment the index and reset it when it reaches 6. The index is not locally bounded before the read. It then jumps to $8FD6, which advances through $0732 when column $6F3C is zero and otherwise jumps to $0200. The entry overlaps the captured character-copy source. The resident left and right speed-update paths at $0E58 and $0FF2 return early when the gate is zero. The conditions were tested with controlled inputs; natural reachability and timing remain open.

Load 26: mutable index for the six-byte gate pattern at $8FD0. The entry snapshot holds zero. The update routine increments it and resets it on reaching 6, but does not locally bound its value before indexing.
Load 26: six captured gate values $FF, $00, $00, $FF, $00, $00, indexed by the mutable byte at $8FCF. The update routine writes the selected value to $E1 when both tested motion-state bytes are zero.

After updating the horizontal-motion gate, compare column $6F3C with zero. Jump to loader-advance entry $0732 when it is zero; otherwise jump to $0200. The test does not establish a natural route to that column.

State 0 copies $1990,X and $197F,X to $1B06,X and $1B17,X, calls $71DB, and uses its returned X as a patched comparison threshold for $6F3C. It stores $00 or $08 at $1AD3,X according to that comparison, sets $1AB1,X to 1, stores the threshold minus 6 with a floor of zero at $1AE4,X, and jumps to $AB0B. The compare operand at $A999 is patched at runtime. The state-table index and entry conditions are not locally bounded; this description does not establish a natural route to the handler.

Compare the value loaded from $6F3C with an immediate byte patched by STX $A999 at $A991 after $71DB returns. The entry snapshot holds $FF; the patched value depends on the caller of $71DB. The branch at $A99A uses the resulting carry.

Use the carry from the column comparison at $A998 to choose $08 when set or $00 when clear, and store it at $1AD3,X. Set $1AB1,X to 1, subtract 6 from the threshold patched at $A999 with a floor of zero, store that value at $1AE4,X and jump to the shared update at $AB0B.

State 1 returns immediately when $1A29,X is zero. Otherwise it compares $6F3C with a window beginning at $1AE4,X and ending at that byte plus $0C, then subtracts $1A and the selected display-slot Y from $49. When those checks pass, it stores the resulting difference shifted right three bits at $1AE4,X and sets $1AB1,X to 2. The arithmetic is eight-bit and can wrap; the non-return paths jump to $AB0B. The state-table index and entry conditions are not locally bounded; this description does not establish a natural route to the handler.

State 2 calls $AB0B and decrements $1AE4,X. A negative result sets $1AB1,X to 3, $1AF5,X to 1 and $1AE4,X to 7. Otherwise it calls $4368 with A=$08, then calls $43A2 when $1AD3,X is zero or $43F0 when it is nonzero. The state-table index and entry conditions are not locally bounded; this description does not establish a natural route to the handler.

State 3 calls $AB0B and $4368, decrements $1AE4,X when nonzero, and increments $1AF5,X unless it equals 5. It calls $43A2 or $43F0 according to $1AD3,X, then compares a shifted display-slot position with $4DAE. On the qualifying side of that comparison, unless $1AB1,X already equals 4, it sets that state to 4, writes $52 or $5E to $1B28,X and toggles bit $08 in $1AD3,X. The state-table index and entry conditions are not locally bounded; this description does not establish a natural route to the handler.

State 4 calls $AB0B and $35C1 with $1B28,X, then compares the 16-bit value $197F/$1990,X with the saved $1B17/$1B06,X using subtraction. If the subtraction borrows, it restores the saved two bytes and sets $1AB1,X to zero; otherwise it returns without that restoration. The state-table index and entry conditions are not locally bounded; this description does not establish a natural route to the handler.

State 5 checks $1A8F,X. When nonzero, it sets $19F6,X to $0F and $19C3,X to $19E5,X plus 6, then jumps to $4574 or $45BC with A=$08 according to $1AD3,X. When zero, it copies $1AC2,X to $19F6,X, clears $1AC2,X and jumps to the shared path at $AA6E. The state-table index and entry conditions are not locally bounded; this description does not establish a natural route to the handler.

State 6 sets $19F6,X to $0F and $19C3,X to $19E5,X plus 6, then decrements $1AC2,X. If the result is nonzero it returns; if zero it calls $4B0E with A=$02 and jumps to $5DB9 with A=$01. The state-table index and entry conditions are not locally bounded; this description does not establish a natural route to the handler.

Increment $1AC2,X, reset it to zero when it reaches 8, and use it to select an offset at $AB61. Add that offset, $19E5,X and $1AD3,X with eight-bit wrap and store the result in $19C3,X. If $1A29,X is zero, return. Otherwise call $732A: on carry set, a positive nonzero $1A6D,X saves $19F6,X to $1AC2,X and selects state 5; zero or negative sets $1AC2,X to $0A and selects state 6. Both paths pop two stack bytes before returning, so they can bypass a caller’s continuation. On carry clear, call $7227; if it returns carry set, call $5D7A with A=$02 and jump to $AA6E, otherwise return. The animation index has no local bounds check before the table read.

Eight captured animation offsets: $00, $00, $02, $02, $04, $04, $02, $02. The shared routine at $AB0B indexes this table after incrementing $1AC2,X; only the equality with 8 resets the index, so other initial values are not locally bounded.
